title: Hinomori Shizuku — A Special Spell〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE - Practice Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That concludes today's practice.
Nice work, you two.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah... Nice work...
Another hard practice...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. We did add a few more exercises today, so I understand why you're tired. Please be sure to get in a good cooldown since we had you did a lot of strength drills today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
I have some fruit slices here. Why don't we have them together?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Fruit slices?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I thought they'd help you all recover, and we chilled them in the refrigerator. You have your choice of strawberries, bananas, pineapples and much more...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, these look so good! Thanks, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What a selection...!
Alright, let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Mmm!
They're cooled just right... I'm feeling better already♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'm glad you're enjoying them so much.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Pardon me. Sorry, I know you're all very tired.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But I'd like to discuss your next offer, Haruka. Do you have a minute to chat...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
I'll be right over.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's amazing...
Haruka's already moving around and talking about work like nothing happened...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd be way too tired to even think.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, despite doing basically the same exercises and drills as us, she seems totally fine... Amazing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She even had you two do more difficult ones today. Planks, jumping drills...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seriously, she was like one of those really mean drill sergeants!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And she kept reminding us to maintain a proper form too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: At the same time, I feel like her being so strict is helping us become stronger bit by bit!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I agree!
She's helping us push past our limits!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They've both been working so hard.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (These drills and exercises aren't easy, but they're doing their best to get ready for Idol Lovers...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I wish I could help them more...
But, in that case...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What if I followed Haruka's example as an instructor?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've actually been thinking about how to teach you two lately.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka is undeniably a wonderful teacher, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not only is she able to come up with good workout regimens, but she knows when to raise her voice in order to get you to keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I've been wondering if I could help you two by being more like the strict instructor that she is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You? Like Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Being really strict...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Stand up, Minori.
We're not done with these exercises yet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? But can't we take a little break...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How can you take a break before making a successful attempt?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Once you've managed to hold that pose for three minutes, then you get to take one. Got it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes, ma'am...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: J-Just one more minute...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Maintain your form, Airi.
How many times are you going to make me warn you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And keep your arms here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Owwww!
M-My back's cramping! Stop, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That's enough for posing. We're going back to square one with stretches. Got it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Eep...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Terrible. Just terrible.
Don't think that you'll be able to go home before finishing, you two.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line: Noooooo!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Y-You're not allowed to be like that, Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I like you just the way you are!!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka's style works for her, but I have a feeling it wouldn't suit you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, for goodness sake!
Please keep being you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: O-Okay, I will...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I thought I could be strict like Haruka...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I suppose that's much easier said than done. In that sense, Haruka really is incredible...)
